scientific_integrity: All-dimensional claim follows from exact Rayleigh inequalities and Walsh diagonalization. Finite exact checks supplement but do not replace proof. Historical priority and independent validation are not certified.
scientific_limitations: Global optimal spectral gap for nonnegative individually weighted distance-one and distance-two edges. Complete optimizer classification is proved for translation-invariant allocations at prices up to two; for prices above two the optimizer is globally unique. Historical full-text access to one 1993 hypercube-walk paper remains unresolved.
title: The spanning-tree polytope in price-optimal one- and two-bit hypercube mixing
